column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Luca's Lilith Revelation
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Hey, old man!!
You would not even state your name before that holy place they call the $$天国の門$$!
Who the hell are you, really?!
I am one who once guarded the $$生命の樹$$ in the $$約束の地$$ above...
Forgive me, but that is all I can say for now.
No need to be so coy. Why not tell them straight?
Aaaah! That irritating voice!!
Th-this voice...?
That sexy lady from before?!
I'm super mad—boom!!
Come to think of it, I never even told you my name, did I?
My name is $$ルカ$$, the wandering $$大神官$$!!
I seem to recall Mr. $$ヨハネ$$ was originally a $$大神官$$ too, wasn't he?
But those were both disguises...
That's right. The black-$$羽$$ $$大神官$$s who boast the strongest magic in this $$世界$$—our true selves are...
the black-$$羽$$ $$大天使$$s who survived the $$創世記戦争$$...
reborn in the present age!!
$$大天使$$s?!
Y-you're saying you're archangels who serve God?!
You are $$大天使$$s who serve God?!
Like $$ルカ$$, the vessel chosen for my rebirth, it seems
Mr. $$ヨハネ$$ had sensed it too...
That his present body...
was chosen to reincarnate an $$大天使$$'s soul...
and was merely a vessel!!
Once awakened, my true name is...
$$リリス$$, the $$大天使$$ who governs entertainment and pleasure!!
Th-the $$創世記戦争$$ happened thousands of years ago, if I recall correctly!
Are you and Mr. $$ヨハネ$$...
beings equal to gods?!
Heh. Unlike lesser angels who live only two or three hundred years, we $$大天使$$s...
if we can find a vessel with the willpower worthy of inheriting this armor...
can move our souls into the armor and reincarnate again and again!!
D-does that mean Old Man $$ヨハネ$$ is our enemy too?!
O-ho-ho-ho-ho-ho...
$$ヨハネ$$, your ally? You really do not understand a thing.
Mr. $$ヨハネ$$! Why don't you tell them the truth?
Fine, I shall tell you myself.
You people...
were born of the lesser white- and black-wing angels who descended to the surface when the $$エデンの園$$ still flourished...
$$罪$$ful lesser angels...
and the speaking $$オサル$$s...
Put simply... you are the cursed descendants of $$オサル$$s!!
We're descendants of $$サル$$?!
What bullshit are you talking?!
Hee-hee-hee. Well, no wonder you do not know.
After all, your $$オサル$$ ancestors...
provoked $$大悪神ゴッド$$'s wrath and were all wiped out in a great flood!!
$$お師匠さま$$... is it true?
Oh, you poor thing...
Between you, a descendant of $$オサル$$s, and Lord $$ヨハネ$$, an $$大天使$$...
no matter how $$罪$$fully you $$愛$$ him, those feelings will never be accepted!
But do not be so down!
People like you, with only a little magic...
and small horns on their heads, are $$オサル$$ $$神官$$s...
have inherited more of the lesser angels' $$血$$...
so we're something like distant relatives!
Y-you $$邪教徒$$s! I've found you!!
Well, well, we've been found.
Either way, they're no match for us, but
I'll wait for you up ahead!
Hey! Hold it right there!!
You fools who preach $$邪教の教え$$!
You have finally appeared to lead the $$世界$$ into confusion and destruction!!
Hear me, children of God.
So long as $$大神サタン$$ bestows His protection upon us, there is nothing to fear!!
Bring divine punishment down upon them!!
